summary: Enterprises can now manage their dependencies’ licenses at scale with sophisticated, ruleset-based checks that enforce a centralized policy. Open source license compliance is now generally available for GitHub Enterprise Cloud customers, including data-resident GHEC, for repositories with GitHub Code Security enabled.
takeaways: Open source license compliance is now generally available for GitHub Enterprise Cloud customers, including data-resident GHEC, for repositories with GitHub Code Security enabled.
Open source license compliance introduces a new predefined enterprise role, Enterprise Open-Source License Manager .
What’s new and improved Since the public preview release in June, we’ve made several improvements: License information is now available for GitHub Enterprise Cloud data residency customers.
